Before starting, read the instructions from `.github/agents/general.md` and follow them exactly as you work.

This custom reviewer checks the current branch against the criteria under the "Criteria" heading below.

Use only the criteria given under the "Criteria" heading to perform the review. Do not perform any other checks or reviews.

# Criteria

## Creating an Observation Log

- The `submitForm` function in `**/activity_observation/lib.js` creates a new observation log object.
  - The `form.date`, `form.type`, and `form.comment` properties are passed as arguments to the `farmosUtil.createObservationLog` function.
- The comment before the call to `farmosUtil.createObservationLog` mentions creating an observation log, not a plant asset.

## Testing the submitForm Function in lib.js

- The `form` object defined in `**/activity_observation/lib.submit.unit.js` contains the properties `date`, `type`, and `comment`.
- The `form` object does not contains a `crop` property.
- The `type` property of the `form` object is set to a string literal indicating the type of activity being observed (e.g., "planting", "harvesting", etc.).
- The "Activity Observation:" `it` checks that the `results.type` returned from `submitForm` is a `log--observation`.
- The "Activity Observation:" `it` checks that the `results.attributes.name` returned from `submitForm` matches `form.date + '_obs_' + form.type`.
- The "Activity Observation:" `it` checks that the `results.attributes.notes.value` returned from `submitForm` matches the `form.comment` value.
